name: Metabase
description: Metabase connects to your databases and turns the data into charts and dashboards that each person of the team can read. For teams that want answers from their data with no SQL.
licence_note: Free to self-host. If you change its code and offer it as a service, you must share your changes.
whats_new: The first version of the template.
first_steps: Open the app at once and finish the setup: the first person who opens it makes the admin account. The first start takes about two minutes.
